findings.summary: 4.U1: CarriedRuns reads the bundle as soon as a running run's workspace opens (Sources is the default tab), and a failed read sets the shared error, shown as a role=alert telling the user to resend text they never sent (EA-8, PR-21, EA-16).
4.U3: scrolling to the latest run (block start) moves the non-sticky thread head, which holds the only ConnectionStatus, out of view at 390x844 Docked (AG-STAT-3).
The outcome row label is built as outcome.${status} from an unvalidated payload, so a status matching another outcome.* key borrows its text; closed enum today, predates the diff.
The report claims a .ea-ws-live container-query fallback that does not exist, and a 4.U4 spec comment states an assertion the spec does not make.
UI architecture section 12 does not describe U2 to U5.
Wording points: nav.legacy versus nav.lastSeen; 'Yêu cầu trước' heading ambiguity; value.receipt.COMMITTED 'Recorded' hides the commit (PR-19); timeline 'Outcome verified · Verified' repeats.
